name: stopwatch
does: A running clock on each calculation (a question with type 'numeric'), in the quiz and on an exam paper that draws calculations (exams[].typed). In the quiz it starts when the question is drawn and stops at the answer, then shows the time taken, which is the time the engine records with the answer (`ms`). With `paceSeconds` set, the clock compares the time with the professor's time per calculation: past it the clock is red and says "over 2:00" (the pace) in words, and an answer within it is shown in green. On an exam paper the time on each question is added up while that question is on screen, the clock of a calculation shows that total, and each answer of the paper keeps its total as `ms` (the engine records no time for paper answers). Reads no course data.
